purpose: The Wallet Service manages customer wallet balances and executes top-ups, transfers, and profile changes.

components.name: Mobile API Gateway
components.evidence: the single ingress for mobile traffic and, as explained in section 6, for a few other callers.

components.name: Keycloak
components.evidence: the identity provider for customers. The gateway asks it to validate every token.

components.name: wallet-core
components.evidence: which implements the business rules: balances, top-ups, transfers and profile.

components.name: wallet-db (PostgreSQL)
components.evidence: the datastore for balances, transactions and owner profiles.

flows.evidence: the gateway asks it to validate every token.
wallet-core reads and writes balances and transactions in wallet-db.
